segments.text: PGBot checks your Postgress database's health without touching it. No agent, no write access, just a readonly role and the stats views Postgress already
tracks. It scores the database 0 to 100 and flags findings as critical, warning, note or good. It keeps a local baseline
so it knows what got worse since last time. It also knows the quirks of RDS, Superbase, and Neon.
